capabilities: Toggle bold and italic using your chosen underscore or asterisk markers
Remove either emphasis style when toggling inside existing markers
Handle word-under-cursor, multi-cursor and multi-line selections like the built-in toggle
Apply your markers in hotkeys, command palette, Format menu and mobile toolbar
Leave underscores inside words like snake_case untouched
disambiguation: Not a visual or CSS styling plugin; it changes which Markdown markers the bold and italic toggles insert.
extras: README documents testing against Obsidian 1.15's own toggle behavior (58 logic cases plus 13 end-to-end checks); no network access and only three settings stored.
intentEvidence: Everywhere Obsidian toggles bold/italic: the hotkeys, the command palette and the right-click Format menu use your markers
motivation: The author built it to fill a forum request for underscore emphasis support that had been open since 2021.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Ctrl/Cmd+I and Ctrl/Cmd+B always insert asterisk markers, so notes that use underscore emphasis end up with mixed styles.
summary: Bold/italic toggle replacement that inserts your preferred markers (_italic_, **bold**) and removes either style when toggling off.
